about: Dates above the local conference for the year ahead: North American Division (division) and world church (general-conference) events and emphases, plus the funding and registration deadlines a local church must meet. Every item has its source URL. confirmed:false = the date is expected or repeats last year's, but this year's page does not show it yet. Each confirmed item's quoted source text was re-checked by build-above.mjs against a saved copy in above-src/raw or above-src/conf.

fields.event: title, start, end (ISO dates), level, owner, category (same list as the conference event files), kind, audience, url, note, confirmed, datePrecision (day|month); optional category2, alsoUrl, repeats {count, dates}, checkedVia
fields.deadline: title, date, appliesTo ("all" or conference slugs), level (division|union|conference), kind, what, url, note, confirmed, basis (dated = this year's date is printed; standing-rule = an undated form gives the same day every year; pattern = last year's date, this year's not posted; announced = a page says it opens that month); optional datePrecision, alsoUrl
fields.rollingRules: deadlines counted back from your own meeting date: appliesTo, rule, leadDays, url, confirmed
fields.beyondWindow: items just after 30 Sep 2027 that churches prepare for during the window (not counted in events or deadlines)

rollingRules.rule: Ask the conference president for evangelism funds at least 90 days before the series.
rollingRules.note: From the v47 research (read 1 Oct 2026); the policy PDF sits behind an expiring link.

rollingRules.rule: Send the evangelism budget to the conference treasurer at least 8 months before the series.
Apply at least 6 months before the meetings for 100% of the appropriation (30% at 5-2 months, 10% at 1 month).
Final budget request (and any changed speaker form) 60 days before the meetings.
Request meeting funds 60 days before the event (pre-work funds as needed).
Itemised budget requests at least 2 months before the meetings; ask for cheques at least 3 months ahead; no cheques before 1 January.
Outreach-event budget requests at least two months before the event (no published date for series requests).
Evangelism requests at least one week before one of the six yearly Evangelism Committee meetings (meeting dates not published).
Requests are per calendar year; ask for approved funds at least three weeks before you need them. The 2027 form is not posted yet (only the 2026 form).
